title: land runs a code-branch push that timed out once more before it stops
goal: when kbgit.py sync's push of a code/<id> branch ends on the network timeout, land retries it once and stops only on a second timeout, naming both

run: import sys,re; t=open("_tools/kg_sync.py",encoding="utf-8").read()+open("_tools/bl_land.py",encoding="utf-8").read(); ok=re.search(r"GitNetworkTimeout[\s\S]{0,400}(retry|once more|again)",t) is not None; print("push timeout retried:",ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: SP-jplczvj2 close: ST-corcepuz and ST-ijamqlyh landings stopped at kbgit.py sync --push with 'git push did not finish within 120 s'; each rerun pushed in about 40 s.
